note: Fictional invoice, purchase order and goods receipt datasets. Most invoices match their PO and goods receipt cleanly and raise no exception; the anchor invoices below are placed deliberately, one per rule, so every documented exception is testable against the fixed reference date 2026-06-30.

scenarios.name: Duplicate invoices
scenarios.description: Two invoices from the same supplier for 1,210.00 EUR on the same date, against different purchase orders.
scenarios.expects: The second invoice is flagged as a duplicate (double-payment risk).

scenarios.name: Duplicate invoice number for a supplier
scenarios.description: Invoice number INV-ANOM-02 is used on two different invoices from the same supplier.
scenarios.expects: The second use of the invoice number is flagged.

scenarios.name: Missing purchase order
scenarios.description: Invoice references purchase order 4599999999, which is absent from the PO file.
scenarios.expects: Flagged as a missing purchase order.

scenarios.name: Missing goods receipt
scenarios.description: Invoice matches a purchase order but no goods receipt exists for the line.
scenarios.expects: Flagged as a missing goods receipt.

scenarios.name: Price mismatch
scenarios.description: Invoiced unit price 130 against a purchase-order price of 100.
scenarios.expects: Flagged as a price mismatch beyond the price tolerance.

scenarios.name: Quantity mismatch
scenarios.description: Invoiced quantity 8 against a received quantity of 10.
scenarios.expects: Flagged as a quantity mismatch versus the receipt.

scenarios.name: Tax mismatch
scenarios.description: Tax charged is 250 where 19% of the 1,000 net amount is 190.

scenarios.name: Currency mismatch
scenarios.description: Invoice is in USD while the purchase order is in EUR.

scenarios.name: Supplier mismatch
scenarios.description: The invoicing supplier differs from the supplier on the purchase order.

scenarios.name: Freight mismatch
scenarios.description: Freight of 900 on a 1,000 net invoice, above the freight policy ceiling.

scenarios.name: Payment-term mismatch
scenarios.description: Invoice states NT60 while the purchase order agreed NT30.

scenarios.name: Three-way-match exception
scenarios.description: Invoiced 10 units but only 7 were accepted at goods receipt (3 rejected).
scenarios.expects: Flagged as a three-way-match exception (billed above accepted quantity).

scenarios.name: Overbilling
scenarios.description: Two invoices of 10 units are booked against a purchase-order line ordered for 10.
scenarios.expects: The second invoice pushes cumulative invoicing above the ordered quantity and is flagged.

scenarios.name: Invoice before purchase order
scenarios.description: Invoice dated 2026-03-20, before its purchase order was raised on 2026-04-01.
scenarios.expects: Flagged as an invoice dated before the purchase order.

scenarios.name: Invoice before goods receipt
scenarios.description: Invoice dated 2026-03-10, before the goods were received on 2026-03-25.
scenarios.expects: Flagged as an invoice dated before the goods receipt.

scenarios.name: Future invoice date
scenarios.description: Invoice dated 2026-09-15, after the validation reference date 2026-06-30.
scenarios.expects: Flagged as a future invoice date.

scenarios.name: Closed purchase-order invoicing
scenarios.description: Invoice booked against a purchase-order line flagged 'Closed'.
scenarios.expects: Flagged as invoicing against a closed purchase order.
